- *"Excuse me, could I trouble you to fill my mug?"*
- *"If you don’t mind, could you fill my cup?"*
- *"Would it be okay if I asked you to fill my mug?"*

This shows respect for the listener’s autonomy and aligns with cultural norms of politeness.
